claim: The Viamala Gorge is open from 26 March to 1 November 2026 with 359 steps down to the gorge floor between rock walls up to 300 m high; adult admission CHF 10.
quote: March 26 – April 30: 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. ... Adults: CHF 10.00 ... 359 steps descending into the gorge ... rock faces up to 300 m high

claim: The Domleschg Castle Trail runs 16.1 km from Thusis to Rothenbrunnen stations, 4h35, medium difficulty, passing 15 castles/ruins including Hohen Rätien and Baldenstein.
quote: Distance: 16.1 km ... Duration: 4 hours 35 minutes ... Difficulty: Medium ... 15 significant historical sites along the route, including the publicly accessible Hohen Rätien castle complex

claim: The 8.1 km circular hike from Sils i.D. via Hohen Rätien to the Crap Carschenna Bronze Age petroglyphs takes 2h45 with 480 m of climbing, rated easy.
quote: Distance: 8.1 km circular route ... Duration: 2 hours 45 minutes ... Elevation Gain/Loss: 480 meters ... Difficulty: Simple ... Bronze Age rock carvings discovered in 1965 featuring circles, spirals, bowls, horses with riders

claim: The Carschenna petroglyphs above Sils im Domleschg date to the 2nd/1st millennium BC, were found by chance in 1965 and are accessible year-round at no charge.
quote: among the most important prehistoric sites in Switzerland ... Bronze and Iron Ages (2nd/1st millennium BC) ... discovered accidentally in 1965 ... publicly accessible year-round at no charge

claim: The Ruinaulta Sut hike from Trin Digg via Ransun to Versam-Safien station covers 21.4 km / ~917 m climb in roughly 6h50, medium-difficulty with viewpoints Islabord, Spitg and Zault.
quote: 21.4 km, approximately 6 hours 50 minutes ... 917 m ascent ... Multiple viewpoints (Islabord, Spitg, Zault) ... Spectacular suspension bridge at Trin Station

claim: The Il Spir observation platform at Conn near Flims offers a 180-degree panorama over the Ruinaulta some 400 m above the Vorderrhein and is reachable on foot from Flims in under an hour.
quote: 180-degree panoramic view over the Ruinaulta ... river lying some 400 meters below ... easily reached from Flims by foot in less than an hour

claim: Lake Cauma (Caumasee) near Flims has turquoise swimming water 17–24°C, daily bathing 8:30–17:00 in summer 2026, with a free funicular descending 80 m to the shore.
quote: bathing facilities at Caumasee are open daily from 8.30 am to 5.00 pm ... water has temperatures between 17 and 24 degrees Celsius ... free Caumasee lift takes you comfortably down 80 metres in altitude

claim: The Alter Schyn historic route runs through the Schyn gorge between Sils im Domleschg and Tiefencastel, carved into the cliff ~500 m above the valley with a lit ~80 m rock tunnel.
quote: the Alte Schyn, runs through the wall around 500 m above the valley floor and is carved into the rock, relatively wide, secured with handrails and an approximately 80-metre-long tunnel with lighting

claim: The Solis Viaduct east of Solis is an 11-arch limestone railway bridge spanning the Albula, built 1902 for the Rhaetian Railway and at 89 m the highest on the RhB network.
quote: single track eleven-arched limestone railway viaduct that spans the Albula east of the hamlet of Solis ... built in 1902 ... height of 89 metres (292 ft), the Solis Viaduct is the highest on the Rhaetian Railway

claim: Piz Beverin (2998 m) in Beverin Nature Park is climbed from Mathon via the Beverin Gap and ridge, with descent over an 8 m ladder and the Beverin Pintg; the park hosts ~380 ibex.
quote: The hike to Piz Beverin starts from Mathon. The easier path leads first over the Beverin Gap and then via the ridge to the summit. The descent route goes over the 8 m high ladder, the Beverin Pintg ... 380 animals in the ibex colony

claim: The Heinzenberg above Thusis offers gentle hiking ridges with panoramic views over the Domleschg castle landscape, Piz Beverin and the Safiental from routes like the Tschappinerrunde.
quote: Heinzenberg stands above Thusis and offers gentle slopes, charming hedgerows, secluded mountain huts and incredible views over the Burgenland Domleschg ... magnificent view of the scattered settlements of the Safiental, Piz Beverin and Domleschg

claim: There is no continuous trail between Versam and Trin stations through the Rhine Gorge; walkers either use the RhB train or a higher 3-hour route via Pintrun and Trin Digg.
quote: There is no continuous hiking trail between Versam Station and Trin Station, so this section must be traveled by the Rhaetian Railway ... hiking trail from Versam Station via Pintrun and Trin Digg to Station Trin in around 3 hours

claim: A Flims-Fidaz-Trin Mulin-Crestasee circular hike covers 11 km in about 3h30 with ~380 m climbing, rated intermediate.
quote: circular route from Flims via Fidaz and Trin Mulin over Lake Cresta takes 3 hours 30 minutes and covers 11.0 km with 1,250 ft elevation gain
